## What I Do

I guide bounded feature implementation with existing patterns, minimal scope, and focused verification.

## When To Use Me

- when adding a new feature that fits current architecture
- when scope can remain bounded to one coherent outcome
- when verification should be explicit and proportional

## Do Not Use Me For

- broad redesigns
- cross-cutting refactors disguised as features

## Workflow

1. confirm scope and non-goals
2. identify existing pattern to follow
3. implement smallest complete slice
4. verify with the smallest meaningful proof
5. summarize outcome, evidence, and follow-up

## Gotchas

- do not expand into unrelated cleanup
- do not skip verification evidence
